newsitem.title: GERMANY: German auto maker Audi wins ads/mktg award.
newsitem.headline: German auto maker Audi wins ads/mktg award.

text.p: German Communications Association BDW said on Wednesday luxury auto maker Audi AG had won its award for excellence in advertising and marketing for 1997.

The industry group said Audi had succeeded in placing itself among the most important competitors for German car giants Mercedes-Benz and BMW by integrating its communication strategy into its corporate planning.
The award will be officially presented to Audi in October.
